<thought>Based on the observed isotopic envelope (dominant peak at 134.11 Da, M+1 ≈11 % of M, M+2 ≈0.5 % of M, M+3 ≈0.016 % of M, etc.), the pattern matches the statistical distribution expected for a molecule containing roughly ten carbon atoms (C‑13 natural abundance ≈1.1 %). No other element shows a characteristic isotopic pattern (e.g., Cl, Br). Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified from the spectrum.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
